critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1500 lines — splitting into routers (auth/discounts/redemptions/qr/admin/subscription/webauthn) is overdue.

/qr/verify auto-consumes on first successful scan by anyone with the URL. Because the qr_value is a plain public URL, any user (or bot) that intercepts the QR image (screenshot shared, camera roll leak) can burn the redemption without the merchant scanning. Consider requiring a merchant-side confirmation (soft-scan then merchant confirms) or short-lived tokens (already 20s but slot=±1 gives up to ~60s window).
/qr/verify does not rate-limit; a scanner could enumerate tokens/hmac (12 hex chars = 48 bits, brute force impractical but still consider rate limiting per IP).

current_month_key relies on server UTC time, but the redemption month rule is 'calendar month' which for Italy is Europe/Rome. Around midnight UTC on the last day of the month CET/CEST users may be reset one hour late/early. Consider using ZoneInfo('Europe/Rome').
Admin master password ADMIN_MASTER_PASSWORD compared with '==' (not hmac.compare_digest) — carried over from iter3.
The 'discount_percent' returned by /qr/verify is None when original_price is falsy; if data has original_price=0 UI hides badge silently. Not a bug but worth noting.

MerchantDiscount.jsx uses readOnly on submit but form inputs are still enabled while locked — banner says 'blocked' and submit is disabled, but a merchant could still type. Consider disabling the fieldset.
